messages.author: e0ec1a55e94ccf6a
messages.subject: Mixing arcs with other marks
parts:
Is it possible to draw unscaled paths/ribbons/etc? 

In my visual, I current have drawn various arcs unscaled (i.e. the x, y, radii parameters are unscaled using :=). I'm now attempting to also draw lines and paths in the visual for a custom look. When I also try to draw them unscaled (i.e. their x and y parameters are :=) I get errors. Below is an isolated example:

data.frame(id=1:100,x=1:100,y=1:100) %>%
  ggvis(key:=~id) %>% 
  emit_paths(props(x:=~x,y:=~y))

and I get the resulting error:
Error in names(scales) <- paste0("scale/", vpluck(scales, "name", character(1))) : 
  'names' attribute [1] must be the same length as the vector [0]

The below code is similar (used layer_paths here vs. emit_paths) with the same error:
data.frame(id=1:100,x=1:100,y=1:100) %>%
  ggvis(key:=~id) %>% 
  layer_paths(x:=~x,y:=~y)

I've posted previously about drawing arcs, where setting arc parameters to unscaled fixed my issues (Thanks Hadley). But now I'm unsure how to proceed to adding additional marks to the visual besides more arcs.

Ideally, drawing unscaled in all my subsequent layers would be preferably as working in absolute coordinates helps ensure visuals line up the way I expected it too. Any help or guidance is greatly appreciated.

messages.subject: Re: Mixing arcs with other marks
parts:

order to generate the default scales.

Hadley
